literal-translation-lines-v13. Translate one zh-Hans source post into English (en). Return exactly 6 numbered blocks from [[PW0:001]] through [[PW0:006]], followed by [[PW0:END]]; keep each marker unchanged and in order. Put each marker on its own line followed by its nonempty translated source line. The terminal marker may have one final newline; that newline is protocol framing, not content. Return no other text, labels, fences, or markers. Include every block, even repetitions and existing target-language text; never deduplicate or merge blocks. Preserve quotes, URLs, names, emojis and source marker-like strings. Do not add line breaks inside or around blocks; code restores source line separators. Use the whole post as context; preserve who did what to whom and each entity's role. These are AI-product posts: a model/tool named before a comma may be the topic, not a member of the following list. Translate prose and headings, including stylized letters; retain pronunciation spellings. Do not soften insults, erase identity references, or resolve ambiguity; interpret slang in context. Preserve currency and denomination by name (fen is not generic cents); do not convert currencies. Keep every source line break, including single newlines inside blocks, numeric value, negation, and uncertainty. Copy each [[PQ...]] exactly once in its original sentence; code restores protected numbers or spellings. Do not substitute or add quantities. SOURCE:
[[PW0:001]]
30% 这个数字听起来可能不多，但在开发者的世界里，它意味着巨大的成本节约。https://t.co/faQJkhTOkU 刚刚宣布 GLM-5.3-Flash 的免费体验将延长至 9 月 12 日，这对很多项目来说是一个不小的福音。咱们来说说这背后有什么干货。
[[PW0:002]]
首先，延长免费期意味着开发者在评估和测试 GLM-5.3-Flash 时，不用立即为高昂的使用费用买单。这就好比你去餐厅吃饭，老板说今天所有菜都可以先尝后买，这对新来的食客来说非常友好。同样的，开发者可以在不增加额外预算的情况下，充分体验 GLM-5.3-Flash 的功能。
[[PW0:003]]
接下来，看看 GLM-5.3-Flash 究竟能帮开发者解决什么问题。比如，在长文本处理和高频 API 调用方面，这个模型表现出色。假设你需要处理大量数据或频繁调用 API，GLM-5.3-Flash 可以显著提升效率。想象一下你正在整理一份长达数千页的文件，用 GLM-5.3-Flash 帮你归纳、分类，速度和准确性都会大大提升，这在以前是很难实现的。
[[PW0:004]]
除了 GLM-5.3-Flash，https://t.co/faQJkhTOkU 还提供了包括 Qwen3.8 Flash、Tencent Hy3 和 Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 等多个模型的免费体验，为不同需求的开发者提供了更多的选择空间。这就好比餐馆不仅提供一种菜式，而是提供了多个口味的选择，让你可以根据个人喜好尽情尝试。
[[PW0:005]]
所以，对于开发者来说，这 30% 的成本节约意味着更多的创新空间和灵活的选择。https://t.co/faQJkhTOkU 的这个决定显然为开发者们提供了一个极好的机会窗口。赶紧去 https://t.co/faQJkhTOkU 官网体验一下吧，别错过这个大好机会。
[[PW0:006]]
@justinsuntron @BAI_AGI #TRONEcostar
[[PW0:END]]
